component.name: OrchidLights
component.summary: DMX lighting control from the browser
Control de iluminación DMX desde el navegador

description.p: OrchidLights drives DMX lighting rigs from a web interface: the same controls work on the laptop in the booth, on a tablet at the stage and on a phone during the show.

It builds on the lighting engine of QLC+, which supports Art-Net, sACN/E1.31, DMX USB, OSC, MIDI and HID, and ships a library of more than 1700 fixture definitions. Project files remain interchangeable with QLC+.
This release provides the headless engine daemon. The web interface is still in development.
Headless engine daemon: loads QLC+ project files with no user interface and reports their fixtures, universes and functions.
